question: Pointing to a man, Radhika said - "His son's mother is the sister of my son's sister." How is the person related to Radhika?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87a56de162e9b334490db7733674e7aef59028f5f8143051317e0f129848f304.png] ​

Given that,

 
• Radhika points at a man and says that his son's mother is the sister of Radhika's son's sister. 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repea
termock.com/tb/1b669cd2dae1896e1793ef2daee765d5fb00b47ca7e038e36bd442e4470b0a30.png] 

Now, Radhika has 3 children, out of which 2 are daughters and 1 is a son. Now, one of the daughters is married and has a son. The man happens to be The married daughter's husband. Thus, the man is her son in law.

Thus, option 3 is correct.
